title: Tio's composing and drinking
summary: Tio was writing compositions, but drank heavily, missing lessons.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: I was going to ask, it reminds me in New York, I heard years ago of rumors that he had sold some numbers to Ellington, like maybe he'd helped write Mood Indigo, you know, that slow blues type thing. And Barney Bigard once told me, I remember about the last time I saw Barney, when he was back with Louie at the time before the present time, in Chicago. And he said that T.O. had sold him several tunes, he thought. He'd written some of those things. Do you know of any of his composing activities or anything that he ever wrote? Or did your father ever write?

Directly I don't, but I do recall on several times going for lessons, where he would be writing and he used to say that if this ever would go over, what it would mean to him. He said, this is something that I'm composing about. What it is, or how many it is, I don't know. At least you know he was active. Yeah, I know he was active to that extent. You know, speaking of T.O., so many days that I would go there and I would be disappointed because he did drink a lot and he would be drunk. And he said, well I'm sorry, I just can't give you no less today, come back next time, you know, next trip,
one of those things. I don't think anybody ever mentioned, not that we're, we try to specialize in

the way it is. Well no, I mean it's just the way it is. Yeah, it's just facts, it's just the way it was. That was the thing with his claim, where when he had gone back to New York and he had begun drinking again, and after he was told that it was detrimental to him and he would continue that it was short in his life. So his wife had told me, well there's nothing she could do, that's just the way he took it. Yeah, well it's hard to say. And then when he met up with Bayshade up there again, that was it. Because several days she wouldn't see him when she would call to find out he was somewhere with Bayshade.
